name: machaira
description: Sword — a SWORD-family Bible study tool (Vue 3 + Vite frontend, Node SWORD backend)

scripts.dev: npm -w shared run build && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"

scripts.lint: eslint client server shared eslint.config.js scripts/eslint-*.cjs scripts/test-lint.mjs --max-warnings 0
